p: dreams: Who says that he has things revealed to him in dreams.
Let us go after other gods: He shows that to which the false prophets tend.
proveth you: God ordains all these things that his may be known.
put to death: Being convicted by testimonies, and condemned by the judge.
thy brother: All natural affection must give place to God's honour.
soul: Whom you love as your life.
thine hand shall be first upon: As the witness is charged.
thou enquire: Which are appointed to see faults punished.
thou shalt gather all the spoil: Signifying that no idolatry is so detestable, nor more grievously to be punished, than of those who once professed God.
cursed thing to thine hand: Of the spoil of that idolatrous and cursed city, read De 7:26, Jos 7:11.
